name: Single Origin Clove
methodDescription: Picked before the bud opens. Dried until the stem snaps clean.
specimenCopy: A flower bud, picked before it opened. Too early and the oils aren't ready; too late and they're already leaving. The window is roughly a week. Communities across Idukki, Kottayam, Pathanamthitta know when it is by the look of the tree, not a calendar.

sensoryProfile.aroma: Sharp camphor, warm wood, spicy eugenol core
sensoryProfile.flavor: Intense pungent warmth, tongue-numbing spice, sweet background
sensoryProfile.appearance: Plump, reddish-brown dried buds with uniform crowns
